records.expected_text: Inspect the area and make a report At the entrance, the wet floor could cause a BHW or visitor to slip. From a safe position, keep people away from the wet area and request correction from designated staff; confirm who that is. A blocked exit could delay escape. Do not lift the obstruction alone; ask responsible staff to address it and confirm a safe route. A sink without soap is an incomplete hand-hygiene station. Report the missing supply and request an approved alternative before a task requiring it; gloves do not replace handwashing. Record four fields: hazard, potential harm, immediate control and contact. “Be careful” is insufficient. Check the condition again; sending a report does not mean the hazard has been corrected. A checklist should lead to controls and follow-up, not merely count hazards.

Linawin ang saklaw at contact Bago tumulong, nagtatanong si Apple sa awtorisadong staff: “Aling gawain ang saklaw ng pagsasanay ko? Sino ang dapat kong abisuhan tungkol sa basang pasukan? Paano kung hindi siya makontak?” Kailangan niyang kumpirmahin ang pangalan o tungkulin, paraan ng pakikipag-ugnayan at lokal na alternatibong contact. Sa pagsasanay, isulat ang “hindi pa tiyak—kumpirmahin” kung kulang ang sagot. Huwag mag-imbento ng numero o patakaran. Kapag lampas sa pagsasanay o kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon, ihinto muna ang kaugnay na gawain at humingi ng awtorisadong pasya. Kung may aktuwal na exposure o pinsala, humingi agad ng medikal na pagsusuri at iulat ayon sa lokal na proseso; hindi dapat maantala ng papeles ang pagsusuri. Kumpirmahin ang hindi tiyak at gawing tiyak ang ulat bago ang gawain.

Clarify scope and contact Before assisting, Apple asks authorized staff: “Which tasks are within my training? Who should I notify about the wet entrance? What if that person cannot be reached?” She needs to confirm the name or role, contact method and local alternative contact. In practice, write “unknown—confirm” when an answer is missing. Do not invent a number or policy. Pause the related task when it exceeds training or essential protection is missing, and seek an authorized decision. For an actual exposure or injury, seek immediate medical evaluation and report through the local process; paperwork must not delay evaluation. Confirm unknowns and make the report specific before work.

Kilalanin ang limang grupo Limang grupo ang gagamitin sa pagsasanay. Una, sharps: lalagyang malapit sa fill line, na may panganib ng tusok; huwag hawakan ang laman, iulat sa awtorisadong staff. Ikalawa, exposure sa impeksyon: kulang ang sabon sa hugasan, kaya kailangan ng kumpletong hand-hygiene arrangement bago ang kaugnay na gawain. Ikatlo, strain sa katawan: mabigat na bag sa mahabang lakad, na maaaring magdulot ng pananakit; humingi ng tulong o baguhin ang dala ayon sa lokal na plano. Ikaapat, stress o sobrang trabaho: magkakasabay na gawain na walang pahinga, na maaaring magdulot ng pagod at pagkakamali; linawin ang prayoridad at humingi ng suporta. Ikalima, aksidente: basang sahig o harang sa labasan, na maaaring magdulot ng pagkadulas o pagkaantala sa paglabas. Ang init sa field ay dagdag na konsiderasyon: kumpirmahin ang pahinga, tubig at ligtas na ruta. Mga posibleng epekto ito, hindi diagnosis. Hindi nalulutas ng PPE lamang ang bawat panganib. Kumpirmahin ang hindi tiyak at gawing tiyak ang ulat bago ang gawain.

Recognize five groups Use five groups in practice. First, sharps: a container near its fill line presents a puncture risk; do not touch the contents, and report to authorized staff. Second, infection exposure: missing soap means a complete hand-hygiene arrangement is needed before the related task. Third, musculoskeletal strain: a heavy bag on a long walk could cause discomfort; request help or adjust the load under the local plan. Fourth, stress or excessive workload: simultaneous tasks without breaks could cause fatigue and errors; clarify priorities and request support. Fifth, accidents: a wet floor or blocked exit could cause a slip or delay escape. Field heat is an additional consideration: confirm breaks, water and a safe route. These are possible effects, not diagnoses. PPE alone does not resolve every hazard. Confirm unknowns and make the report specific before work.

Gumawa ng ulat, tumanggap ng feedback, ulitin Gumuhit ng limang kahon at magbigay ng halimbawa para sa bawat hazard group mula sa station o home visit. Pumili ng isa at kumpletuhin ang panganib, posibleng pinsala, agarang kontrol at contact. Sa triad, ang BHW ang mag-uulat, ang partner ang sasagot gamit lamang ang scenario card at ang observer ang susuri sa apat na field. Kapag “mag-ingat” lang ang sagot, itanong: “Saang lugar? Ano ang pinsala? Anong tiyak na aksyon? Kanino at paano mag-uulat?” Ulitin ang ulat at idagdag kung kailan babalikan ang kalagayan. Kung hindi pa tiyak ang contact, sabihin kung paano ito kukumpirmahin. Kung mag-isa, sumulat o magsalita gamit ang parehong checklist; ito ay rehearsal, hindi obserbasyon ng trainer. Bago ang susunod na duty, gawin ang maikling hazard check at kumpirmahin ang contact. Ang pagkilala sa panganib ay dapat humantong sa tiyak na kontrol at taong tutugon.

Report, receive feedback, retry Draw five boxes and give a station or home-visit example for each hazard group. Choose one and complete hazard, potential harm, immediate control and contact. In a triad, the BHW reports, the partner answers using only the scenario card, and the observer checks the four fields. If the answer is only “be careful,” ask: “Where? What harm? What specific action? To whom and how will you report?” Repeat the report and add when the condition will be checked again. If the contact is unknown, explain how to confirm it. Working alone, write or speak using the same checklist; this is rehearsal, not trainer observation. Before the next duty, perform a short hazard check and confirm the contact. Recognizing a hazard should lead to a specific control and responsible contact.
